1→# 🦞 OC — OpenClaw Workspace
     2→
     3→This is the workspace for **OC**, Rob's personal AI assistant running on [OpenClaw](https://openclaw.ai), hosted on `simplemap.safecast.org`.
     4→
     5→---
     6→
     7→## AnyType Sync Integration
     8→
     9→The core feature of this workspace is a live bridge between OpenClaw and [AnyType](https://anytype.io) — a self-hosted, privacy-first knowledge graph. When OC writes a file to a watched directory on the VPS, it automatically appears in AnyType across all devices within seconds.
    10→
    11→### How It Works — Big Picture
    12→
    13→```mermaid
    14→graph TB
    15→    subgraph "OpenClaw Bot (VPS)"
    16→        OC[OC — AI Assistant]
    17→        OCLogic[Tool calls / responses]
    18→    end
    19→
    20→    subgraph "VPS Filesystem"
    21→        WD["/root/anytype-workspace/\n.md  .png  .pdf  .mp4  .mp3"]
    22→        ObjMap[".anytype-workspace-objectmap.json\nfilename → AnyType object ID"]
    23→    end
    24→
    25→    subgraph "Sync Service (systemd)"
    26→        Watcher["fsnotify Watcher\nCREATE / WRITE / REMOVE"]
    27→        Debounce["2s Debounce"]
    28→        GRPCClient["gRPC Client\n127.0.0.1:31010"]
    29→        TokenMgr["Session Token Manager\nauto-renewal on auth error"]
    30→    end
    31→
    32→    subgraph "AnyType Local Server"
    33→        ATServe["anytype serve -q\nHeadless, port 31010"]
    34→        Config["~/.anytype/config.json\nJWT session token"]
    35→    end
    36→
    37→    subgraph "Self-Hosted P2P Network"
    38→        Coordinator["Coordinator Node\n:33010 / :33020"]
    39→    end
    40→
    41→    subgraph "Client Devices"
    42→        Laptop["💻 Laptop"]
    43→        Tablet["📱 Tablet / Mobile"]
    44→        Remote["🌍 Remote devices"]
    45→    end
    46→
    47→    OC -->|"writes files"| WD
    48→    WD -->|"inotify event"| Watcher
    49→    Watcher --> Debounce
    50→    Debounce -->|"ObjectCreate / FileUpload RPC"| GRPCClient
    51→    GRPCClient -->|"read token"| Config
    52→    GRPCClient -->|"gRPC call + auth metadata"| ATServe
    53→    ATServe -->|"P2P broadcast"| Coordinator
    54→    Coordinator <-->|"global sync"| Laptop
    55→    Coordinator <-->|"global sync"| Tablet
    56→    Coordinator <-->|"global sync"| Remote
    57→
    58→    GRPCClient -->|"store object ID"| ObjMap
    59→    TokenMgr -->|"restart server on expiry"| ATServe
    60→    GRPCClient --> TokenMgr
    61→```
    62→
    63→---
    64→
    65→### End-to-End Sequence: Creating a Note
    66→
    67→```mermaid
    68→sequenceDiagram
    69→    participant OC as OC (OpenClaw Bot)
    70→    participant FS as /root/anytype-workspace/
    71→    participant Sync as Sync Service
    72→    participant AT as AnyType Server
    73→    participant Net as P2P Network
    74→    participant Dev as All Devices
    75→
    76→    OC->>FS: Write note.md
    77→    FS->>Sync: fsnotify: CREATE event
    78→    Sync->>Sync: Debounce 2 seconds
    79→    Sync->>AT: Read ~/.anytype/config.json → JWT token
    80→    Sync->>AT: gRPC ObjectCreate(title, content, spaceID)
    81→    AT->>AT: Validate session token
    82→    AT-->>Sync: ✓ objectID: bafyreig...
    83→    Sync->>FS: Save objectmap: {"note" → "bafyreig..."}
    84→    AT->>Net: P2P broadcast
    85→    Net->>Dev: Sync to all devices (2–10 seconds)
    86→```
    87→
    88→---
    89→
    90→### File Types Supported
    91→
    92→| Type | Extensions | AnyType Object | RPC Method |
    93→|------|-----------|---------------|------------|
    94→| Markdown | `.md` | Note | `ObjectCreate` |
    95→| Images | `.jpg` `.png` `.gif` `.webp` `.svg` | Image | `FileUpload` |
    96→| Documents | `.pdf` | PDF | `FileUpload` |
    97→| Video | `.mp4` `.mov` `.avi` `.mkv` `.webm` | Video | `FileUpload` |
    98→| Audio | `.mp3` `.wav` `.ogg` `.m4a` `.flac` | Audio | `FileUpload` |
    99→
   100→---
   101→
   102→### Token Auto-Renewal
   103→
   104→AnyType session tokens expire when the server restarts. The sync service detects auth failures and self-heals:
   105→
   106→```mermaid
   107→sequenceDiagram
   108→    participant Sync as Sync Service
   109→    participant Server as anytype serve
   110→    participant Token as config.json (JWT)
   111→
   112→    Sync->>Server: gRPC call
   113→    Server-->>Sync: Error: Not Authenticated
   114→
   115→    Sync->>Sync: Check rate limit (30s cooldown)
   116→
   117→    alt Rate limit OK
   118→        Sync->>Server: pkill anytype serve
   119→        Sync->>Sync: Wait 3 seconds
   120→        Sync->>Server: Start: anytype serve -q
   121→        Sync->>Sync: Wait 8 seconds (init)
   122→        Sync->>Token: Read new session token
   123→        Sync->>Server: Retry original gRPC call
   124→        Server-->>Sync: ✓ Success
   125→    else Too soon (< 30s since last refresh)
   126→        Sync-->>Sync: ✗ Rate limit — will retry on next event
   127→    end
   128→```
   129→
   130→---
   131→
   132→## Setup Guide
   133→
   134→### Prerequisites
   135→
   136→- Ubuntu VPS with root access (tested on 24.04)
   137→- Self-hosted [AnyType network](https://github.com/anyproto/any-sync) with:
   138→  - Network ID and `client-config.yml`
   139→  - Space ID and an invite link (`cid` + `key`)
   140→- Go 1.21+ (for building the sync binary)
   141→
   142→---
   143→
   144→### Step 1 — Install AnyType CLI
   145→
   146→```bash
   147→wget https://github.com/anyproto/anytype-cli/releases/latest/download/anytype-linux-amd64
   148→chmod +x anytype-linux-amd64
   149→mkdir -p /root/.local/bin
   150→mv anytype-linux-amd64 /root/.local/bin/anytype
   151→/root/.local/bin/anytype version
   152→```
   153→
   154→---
   155→
   156→### Step 2 — Create a Bot Account
   157→
   158→```bash
   159→/root/.local/bin/anytype auth create my-sync-bot \
   160→  --network-config /var/lib/anytype/data/client-config.yml
   161→```
   162→
   163→Save the output — you'll need the **Account Key** and **Account ID**.
   164→
   165→---
   166→
   167→### Step 3 — Start AnyType Server and Join Space
   168→
   169→```bash
   170→# Start headless AnyType server
   171→nohup /root/.local/bin/anytype serve -q > /tmp/anytype-serve.log 2>&1 &
   172→sleep 5
   173→
   174→# Verify gRPC is listening
   175→ss -tlnp | grep 31010
   176→
   177→# Join your space
   178→/root/.local/bin/anytype space join \
   179→  'anytype://invite/?cid=YOUR_CID&key=YOUR_KEY' \
   180→  --network YOUR_NETWORK_ID
   181→
   182→# Verify
   183→/root/.local/bin/anytype space list
   184→```
   185→
   186→---
   187→
   188→### Step 4 — Build and Deploy the Sync Service
   189→
   190→```bash
   191→# Build (locally or on VPS)
   192→cd code/anytype-workspace-sync
   193→go build -o anytype-workspace-sync-bin
   194→
   195→# Update spaceID in main.go before building:
   196→# const spaceID = "YOUR_SPACE_ID_HERE"
   197→
   198→# Deploy to VPS
   199→scp anytype-workspace-sync-bin root@YOUR_VPS:/root/
   200→ssh root@YOUR_VPS "mkdir -p /root/anytype-workspace"
   201→```
   202→
   203→---
   204→
   205→### Step 5 — Create Systemd Service
   206→
   207→```bash
   208→cat > /etc/systemd/system/anytype-workspace-sync.service <<'EOF'
   209→[Unit]
   210→Description=AnyType Workspace Sync Service
   211→After=network.target
   212→
   213→[Service]
   214→Type=simple
   215→User=root
   216→WorkingDirectory=/root
   217→ExecStart=/root/anytype-workspace-sync-bin
   218→Restart=always
   219→RestartSec=10
   220→StandardOutput=journal
   221→StandardError=journal
   222→
   223→[Install]
   224→WantedBy=multi-user.target
   225→EOF
   226→
   227→systemctl daemon-reload
   228→systemctl enable --now anytype-workspace-sync.service
   229→```
   230→
   231→Check it's running:
   232→```bash
   233→systemctl status anytype-workspace-sync
   234→journalctl -u anytype-workspace-sync -f
   235→```
   236→
   237→---
   238→
   239→### Step 6 — Test It
   240→
   241→```bash
   242→# Create a test note
   243→echo "# Hello from OC" > /root/anytype-workspace/hello.md
   244→
   245→# Watch the logs
   246→journalctl -u anytype-workspace-sync -n 20
   247→# → [2026-03-01T12:00:00Z] ✓ hello synced to AnyType
   248→
   249→# Delete it
   250→rm /root/anytype-workspace/hello.md
   251→# → [2026-03-01T12:00:05Z] ✓ hello deleted from AnyType
   252→```
   253→
   254→Open your AnyType app — the note should appear (and disappear) within a few seconds.
   255→
   256→---
   257→
   258→## Key File Locations
   259→
   260→| Path | Purpose |
   261→|------|---------|
   262→| `/root/anytype-workspace/` | Watched directory — drop files here |
   263→| `/root/anytype-workspace-sync-bin` | Sync service binary |
   264→| `/root/.anytype/config.json` | AnyType credentials + live JWT session token |
   265→| `/root/.anytype-workspace-objectmap.json` | Maps filenames → AnyType object IDs |
   266→| `/tmp/anytype-serve.log` | AnyType server stdout |
   267→| `/var/lib/anytype/data/client-config.yml` | P2P network configuration |
   268→
   269→---
   270→
   271→## Common Operations
   272→
   273→```bash
   274→# View sync logs (live)
   275→journalctl -u anytype-workspace-sync -f
   276→
   277→# Restart sync service
   278→systemctl restart anytype-workspace-sync
   279→
   280→# Check auth
   281→/root/.local/bin/anytype auth status
   282→
   283→# List spaces
   284→/root/.local/bin/anytype space list
   285→
   286→# Full restart (if stuck)
   287→systemctl stop anytype-workspace-sync
   288→pkill -f 'anytype serve'
   289→sleep 3
   290→nohup /root/.local/bin/anytype serve -q > /tmp/anytype-serve.log 2>&1 &
   291→sleep 8
   292→systemctl start anytype-workspace-sync
   293→```
   294→
   295→---
   296→

1→# AnyType Workspace Sync
     2→
     3→**v1.2.0** - Full file synchronization between local workspace and AnyType self-hosted space via gRPC.
     4→
     5→## Overview
     6→
     7→This tool enables automated synchronization of files (markdown, images, PDFs, videos, audio) to an AnyType self-hosted space, allowing external tools and bots to read/write to AnyType spaces programmatically.
     8→
     9→### Features
    10→
    11→#### File Sync (v1.2.0)
    12→- ✅ **Markdown Notes** (.md) - Text notes with automatic title extraction
    13→- ✅ **Images** (.jpg, .jpeg, .png, .gif, .webp, .bmp, .svg) - Automatic image upload
    14→- ✅ **PDFs** (.pdf) - Document sync
    15→- ✅ **Videos** (.mp4, .mov, .avi, .mkv, .webm) - Video file support
    16→- ✅ **Audio** (.mp3, .wav, .ogg, .m4a, .flac) - Audio file support
    17→
    18→#### Core Features
    19→- ✅ **Create/Update** - Files automatically sync to AnyType as appropriate object types
    20→- ✅ **Delete** - File deletions propagate to AnyType space
    21→- ✅ **File Watching** - Real-time monitoring with fsnotify (2-second debounce)
    22→- ✅ **Object ID Tracking** - Persistent mapping between files and AnyType objects
    23→- ✅ **gRPC Authentication** - Session token-based authentication
    24→- ✅ **Automatic Token Renewal** (v1.1.0) - Self-healing authentication with automatic server restart
    25→- ✅ **Self-Hosted Networks** - Support for custom AnyType P2P networks
    26→- ✅ **Global P2P Sync** - Files appear on all devices worldwide (tested: Finland ↔ Japan)
    27→
    28→## Architecture
    29→
    30→```
    31→┌─────────────────────┐
    32→│  Markdown Files     │
    33→│  /root/anytype-     │
    34→│  workspace/*.md     │
    35→└──────────┬──────────┘
    36→           │
    37→           │ fsnotify watches
    38→           │
    39→           ▼
    40→┌─────────────────────┐
    41→│  anytype-workspace- │
    42→│  sync (Go Service)  │
    43→│  • File watcher     │
    44→│  • Object map       │
    45→│  • gRPC client      │
    46→└──────────┬──────────┘
    47→           │
    48→           │ gRPC (port 31010)
    49→           │ with session token
    50→           │
    51→           ▼
    52→┌─────────────────────┐
    53→│  AnyType Desktop    │
    54→│  (serve -q mode)    │
    55→│  • gRPC server      │
    56→│  • Authentication   │
    57→└──────────┬──────────┘
    58→           │
    59→           │ Syncs to
    60→           │
    61→           ▼
    62→┌─────────────────────┐
    63→│  AnyType Space      │
    64→│  Self-Hosted        │
    65→│  Network            │
    66→└─────────────────────┘
    67→```
    68→
    69→## Prerequisites
    70→
    71→### On VPS (Ubuntu 24.04)
    72→
    73→1. **AnyType Desktop CLI** (`anytype`)
    74→   - Download from: https://github.com/anyproto/anytype-cli
    75→   - Install to: `/root/.local/bin/anytype`
    76→
    77→2. **Go 1.21+** (for building)
    78→   ```bash
    79→   wget https://go.dev/dl/go1.21.0.linux-amd64.tar.gz
    80→   tar -C /usr/local -xzf go1.21.0.linux-amd64.tar.gz
    81→   export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin
    82→   ```
    83→
    84→3. **AnyType Self-Hosted Network**
    85→   - Network ID
    86→   - Network configuration YAML file
    87→   - Space invite link (CID + key)
    88→
    89→### On Development Machine
    90→
    91→- Go 1.21+
    92→- SSH access to VPS
    93→- Git
    94→
    95→## Installation
    96→
    97→### 1. Clone the Repository
    98→
    99→```bash
   100→git clone <repository-url>
   101→cd anytype-workspace-sync
   102→```
   103→
   104→### 2. Build the Binary
   105→
   106→```bash
   107→/usr/local/go/bin/go build -o anytype-workspace-sync-bin
   108→```
   109→
   110→### 3. Deploy to VPS
   111→
   112→```bash
   113→scp anytype-workspace-sync-bin root@YOUR_VPS:/root/
   114→```
   115→
   116→### 4. Create Workspace Directory
   117→
   118→```bash
   119→ssh root@YOUR_VPS "mkdir -p /root/anytype-workspace"
   120→```
   121→
   122→### 5. Configure AnyType Account
   123→
   124→#### Create Account with Network Configuration
   125→
   126→```bash
   127→# On VPS
   128→/root/.local/bin/anytype auth create YOUR_BOT_NAME \
   129→  --network-config /var/lib/anytype/data/client-config.yml
   130→```
   131→
   132→This will output:
   133→- Account ID (e.g., `REDACTED`)
   134→- Account Key (save this securely!)
   135→
   136→#### Login with Account
   137→
   138→```bash
   139→/root/.local/bin/anytype auth login \
   140→  --account-key 'YOUR_ACCOUNT_KEY' \
   141→  --network-config /var/lib/anytype/data/client-config.yml
   142→```
   143→
   144→### 6. Join the Space
   145→
   146→Get invite link from space owner, then:
   147→
   148→```bash
   149→/root/.local/bin/anytype space join \
   150→  'anytype://invite/?cid=INVITE_CID&key=INVITE_KEY' \
   151→  --network YOUR_NETWORK_ID
   152→```
   153→
   154→Verify space is joined:
   155→
   156→```bash
   157→/root/.local/bin/anytype space list
   158→```
   159→
   160→### 7. Start AnyType Server
   161→
   162→```bash
   163→nohup /root/.local/bin/anytype serve -q > /tmp/anytype-serve.log 2>&1 &
   164→```
   165→
   166→Verify it's running:
   167→
   168→```bash
   169→ss -tlnp | grep 31010
   170→```
   171→
   172→Should show: `LISTEN 0 4096 127.0.0.1:31010`
   173→
   174→### 8. Create Systemd Service
   175→
   176→Create `/etc/systemd/system/anytype-workspace-sync.service`:
   177→
   178→```ini
   179→[Unit]
   180→Description=AnyType Workspace Sync Service
   181→After=network.target
   182→
   183→[Service]
   184→Type=simple
   185→User=root
   186→WorkingDirectory=/root
   187→ExecStart=/root/anytype-workspace-sync-bin
   188→Restart=always
   189→RestartSec=10
   190→StandardOutput=journal
   191→StandardError=journal
   192→
   193→[Install]
   194→WantedBy=multi-user.target
   195→```
   196→
   197→Enable and start:
   198→
   199→```bash
   200→systemctl daemon-reload
   201→systemctl enable anytype-workspace-sync.service
   202→systemctl start anytype-workspace-sync.service
   203→```
   204→
   205→### 9. Verify Operation
   206→
   207→Check logs:
   208→
   209→```bash
   210→journalctl -u anytype-workspace-sync -f
   211→```
   212→
   213→You should see:
   214→```
   215→[2026-03-01T12:00:00Z] Connected to AnyType
   216→[2026-03-01T12:00:00Z] Initial sync complete
   217→[2026-03-01T12:00:00Z] Watching /root/anytype-workspace for changes...
   218→```
   219→
   220→## Configuration
   221→
   222→### Environment Variables
   223→
   224→The tool reads configuration from:
   225→
   226→- `HOME` - Used to locate `~/.anytype/config.json`
   227→- Default workspace: `/root/anytype-workspace`
   228→- Default gRPC address: `127.0.0.1:31010`
   229→
   230→### Space ID
   231→
   232→Update [main.go](main.go:16) with your space ID:
   233→
   234→```go
   235→const (
   236→    spaceID = "bafyreig4q7t3vt7b7zmvfv3emj7jfrvjamuhu4crws3dhn3uaxhh3u37k4.10piockh34xft"
   237→)
   238→```
   239→
   240→### Network Configuration
   241→
   242→The network config file should be at:
   243→```
   244→/var/lib/anytype/data/client-config.yml
   245→```
   246→
   247→Example format:
   248→```yaml
   249→id: YOUR_CONFIG_ID
   250→networkId: YOUR_NETWORK_ID
   251→nodes:
   252→  - peerId: PEER_ID
   253→    addresses:
   254→      - quic://hostname:33020
   255→      - hostname:33010
   256→    types:
   257→      - coordinator
   258→      - consensus
   259→      - tree
   260→      - file
   261→```
   262→
   263→## Usage
   264→
   265→### Create/Update Files
   266→
   267→```bash
   268→echo "# My Note\nContent here" > /root/anytype-workspace/my-note.md
   269→```
   270→
   271→The file will be automatically synced to AnyType within 2 seconds.
   272→
   273→### Delete Files
   274→
   275→```bash
   276→rm /root/anytype-workspace/my-note.md
   277→```
   278→
   279→The corresponding object will be deleted from AnyType.
   280→
   281→### Check Sync Status
   282→
   283→```bash
   284→# View logs
   285→journalctl -u anytype-workspace-sync -n 50
   286→
   287→# Check object mappings
   288→cat /root/.anytype-workspace-objectmap.json
   289→```
   290→
   291→### List Synced Objects
   292→
   293→```bash
   294→/root/.local/bin/anytype space list
   295→```
   296→
   297→## Object ID Mapping
   298→
   299→The tool maintains a persistent mapping in `/root/.anytype-workspace-objectmap.json`:
   300→
   301→```json
   302→{
   303→  "my-note": "REDACTED",
   304→  "another-note": "REDACTED"

   307→
   308→This allows the tool to:
   309→- Track which files map to which AnyType objects
   310→- Delete the correct object when a file is removed
   311→- Survive service restarts
   312→
   313→## Troubleshooting
   314→
   315→### Authentication Errors
   316→
   317→**Symptom**: `not authenticated - check network membership`
   318→
   319→**Automatic Recovery**: The service now includes automatic token renewal! When an authentication error is detected:
   320→1. The service automatically restarts the AnyType server
   321→2. Waits for a fresh session token to be generated
   322→3. Reloads the new token from config
   323→4. Retries the failed operation

   325→You should see logs like:

   327→⚠ Authentication error detected: not authenticated

   329→  → Stopping anytype server...
   330→  → Starting anytype server...
   331→  → Waiting for server to initialize...
   332→  → Reading new session token...
   333→✓ Session token refreshed successfully

   363→
   364→3. Check logs for errors:

   367→   ```
   368→
   369→### Space Not Found

   373→   ```bash

   375→   ```
   376→
   377→2. Correct space ID in [main.go](main.go:16)

   379→3. Account has Editor permissions in the space

   383→**Check**:

   387→   ```
   388→
   389→2. AnyType server logs:
   390→   ```bash
   391→   tail -f /tmp/anytype-serve.log
   392→   ```
   393→
   394→### Object Map Corrupted

   396→**Reset**:
   397→```bash
   398→rm /root/.anytype-workspace-objectmap.json

   400→```

   428→## API Reference

1→# AnyType Workspace Sync - Technical Architecture
     2→
     3→This document describes the technical architecture, design decisions, and implementation details of the AnyType Workspace Sync system.
     4→
     5→## System Overview
     6→
     7→The system enables programmatic access to self-hosted AnyType spaces by bridging filesystem operations with AnyType's gRPC API.
     8→
     9→```
    10→┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    11→│                    External Systems                           │
    12→│                  (Bots, Scripts, Tools)                       │
    13→└─────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────────┘
    14→                      │
    15→                      │ Writes markdown files
    16→                      ▼
    17→┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    18→│              Filesystem Layer                                 │
    19→│                                                                │
    20→│  /root/anytype-workspace/*.md                                │
    21→│  - test-note.md                                               │
    22→│  - project-doc.md                                             │
    23→│  - meeting-notes.md                                           │
    24→└─────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────────┘
    25→                      │
    26→                      │ fsnotify events
    27→                      ▼
    28→┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    29→│           anytype-workspace-sync Service                      │
    30→│                                                                │
    31→│  ┌──────────────┐  ┌──────────────┐  ┌──────────────┐       │
    32→│  │ File Watcher │  │ Object Map   │  │ gRPC Client  │       │
    33→│  │  (fsnotify)  │  │  (JSON DB)   │  │ (with auth)  │       │
    34→│  └──────┬───────┘  └──────┬───────┘  └──────┬───────┘       │
    35→│         │                  │                  │                │
    36→│         └──────────────────┴──────────────────┘                │
    37→└─────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────────┘
    38→                      │
    39→                      │ gRPC over localhost:31010
    40→                      │ (with session token)
    41→                      ▼
    42→┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    43→│         AnyType Desktop (serve -q mode)                       │
    44→│                                                                │
    45→│  ┌──────────────┐  ┌──────────────┐  ┌──────────────┐       │
    46→│  │ gRPC Server  │  │   Auth       │  │ Space Mgmt   │       │
    47→│  │  :31010      │  │ Middleware   │  │              │       │
    48→│  └──────┬───────┘  └──────┬───────┘  └──────┬───────┘       │
    49→│         │                  │                  │                │
    50→│         └──────────────────┴──────────────────┘                │
    51→└─────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────────┘
    52→                      │
    53→                      │ P2P sync
    54→                      ▼
    55→┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    56→│         Self-Hosted AnyType Network                           │
    57→│                                                                │
    58→│  ┌──────────────┐  ┌──────────────┐  ┌──────────────┐       │
    59→│  │  Coordinator │  │   Consensus  │  │  File Node   │       │
    60→│  │  (MongoDB)   │  │   (MongoDB)  │  │   (Redis)    │       │
    61→│  └──────────────┘  └──────────────┘  └──────────────┘       │
    62→└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
    63→```
    64→
    65→## Component Details
    66→
    67→### 1. File Watcher (fsnotify)
    68→
    69→**Purpose**: Monitor filesystem for changes in real-time.
    70→
    71→**Implementation**:
    72→```go
    73→watcher, _ := fsnotify.NewWatcher()
    74→watcher.Add("/root/anytype-workspace")
    75→
    76→for {
    77→    select {
    78→    case event := <-watcher.Events:
    79→        if event.Op&fsnotify.Remove == fsnotify.Remove {
    80→            DeleteFile(event.Name)
    81→        } else if event.Op&fsnotify.Write == fsnotify.Write {
    82→            SyncFile(event.Name)
    83→        }
    84→    }
    85→}
    86→```
    87→
    88→**Features**:
    89→- Recursive directory watching
    90→- Debouncing (2 second delay to avoid duplicate events)
    91→- File timestamp tracking
    92→- `.md` file filtering
    93→
    94→**Events Handled**:
    95→- `Create` - New file created → Sync to AnyType
    96→- `Write` - File modified → Update in AnyType
    97→- `Remove` - File deleted → Delete from AnyType
    98→
    99→### 2. Object Map (Persistent Storage)
   100→
   101→**Purpose**: Maintain bidirectional mapping between filenames and AnyType object IDs.
   102→
   103→**File Location**: `/root/.anytype-workspace-objectmap.json`
   104→
   105→**Structure**:
   106→```json
   107→{
   108→  "filename-without-extension": "bafyreif6xrpi4yx4fmhy7...",
   109→  "another-file": "bafyreickujocrhaglvvru..."
   110→}
   111→```
   112→
   113→**Implementation**:
   114→```go
   115→type ObjectMap struct {
   116→    mu      sync.RWMutex
   117→    mapping map[string]string
   118→}
   119→
   120→func (om *ObjectMap) Set(filename, objectID string) error {
   121→    om.mu.Lock()
   122→    defer om.mu.Unlock()
   123→    om.mapping[filename] = objectID
   124→    return om.save()
   125→}
   126→```
   127→
   128→**Thread Safety**: Uses `sync.RWMutex` for concurrent access.
   129→
   130→**Persistence**: Saves to disk after every modification.
   131→
   132→**Use Cases**:
   133→1. **Create/Update**: Store object ID after successful creation
   134→2. **Delete**: Look up object ID, delete from AnyType, remove from map
   135→3. **Restart Recovery**: Load mappings from disk on service start
   136→
   137→### 3. gRPC Client
   138→
   139→**Purpose**: Communicate with AnyType's gRPC API for object operations.
   140→
   141→**Connection**:
   142→```go
   143→conn, _ := grpc.Dial("127.0.0.1:31010",
   144→    grpc.WithTransportCredentials(insecure.NewCredentials()))
   145→client := service.NewClientCommandsClient(conn)
   146→```
   147→
   148→**Authentication**:
   149→```go
   150→// Read session token from config
   151→token := readSessionToken() // from ~/.anytype/config.json
   152→
   153→// Add to every request
   154→ctx = metadata.AppendToOutgoingContext(ctx, "token", token)
   155→```
   156→
   157→**RPCs Used**:
   158→
   159→1. **WorkspaceOpen** - Opens a space for operations
   160→   ```go
   161→   resp, _ := client.WorkspaceOpen(ctx, &pb.RpcWorkspaceOpenRequest{
   162→       SpaceId: spaceID,
   163→   })
   164→   ```
   165→
   166→2. **ObjectCreate** - Creates a new note
   167→   ```go
   168→   resp, _ := client.ObjectCreate(ctx, &pb.RpcObjectCreateRequest{
   169→       SpaceId:             spaceID,
   170→       Details:             details,
   171→       ObjectTypeUniqueKey: "ot-note",
   172→   })
   173→   ```
   174→
   175→3. **ObjectListDelete** - Deletes objects
   176→   ```go
   177→   resp, _ := client.ObjectListDelete(ctx, &pb.RpcObjectListDeleteRequest{
   178→       ObjectIds: []string{objectID},
   179→   })
   180→   ```
   181→
   182→### 4. AnyType Desktop (Server Mode)
   183→
   184→**Start Command**:
   185→```bash
   186→anytype serve -q
   187→```
   188→
   189→**Features**:
   190→- Runs headless (no GUI)
   191→- gRPC server on `127.0.0.1:31010`
   192→- gRPC-Web proxy on `127.0.0.1:31011`
   193→- Auto-login from stored credentials
   194→
   195→**Authentication Flow**:
   196→1. Reads account key from `/root/.anytype/config.json`
   197→2. Generates session token
   198→3. Stores token back in config
   199→4. Validates token on every gRPC request
   200→
   201→**Session Token Format**:
   202→```
   203→eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.REDACTED.xWn_B2psFw1...
   204→```
   205→- JWT (JSON Web Token)
   206→- HS256 algorithm
   207→- Contains account seed
   208→
   209→## Data Flow
   210→
   211→### Create/Update Flow
   212→
   213→```
   214→1. User/Bot creates file
   215→   ↓
   216→   echo "# Note" > /root/anytype-workspace/note.md
   217→
   218→2. fsnotify detects Write event
   219→   ↓
   220→   event.Op == fsnotify.Write
   221→
   222→3. Debounce check (2 seconds)
   223→   ↓
   224→   if now - lastChange < 2s: skip
   225→
   226→4. Parse markdown file
   227→   ↓
   228→   title := extractTitle(content)
   229→   content := readFile()
   230→
   231→5. Create gRPC request
   232→   ↓
   233→   ObjectCreate(title, content, spaceID)
   234→
   235→6. Add authentication
   236→   ↓
   237→   ctx = withAuth(ctx, sessionToken)
   238→
   239→7. Send to AnyType
   240→   ↓
   241→   resp := client.ObjectCreate(ctx, req)
   242→
   243→8. Store object ID
   244→   ↓
   245→   objectMap.Set("note", resp.ObjectId)
   246→
   247→9. Log success
   248→   ↓
   249→   ✓ note synced to AnyType
   250→```
   251→
   252→### Delete Flow
   253→
   254→```
   255→1. User/Bot deletes file
   256→   ↓
   257→   rm /root/anytype-workspace/note.md
   258→
   259→2. fsnotify detects Remove event
   260→   ↓
   261→   event.Op == fsnotify.Remove
   262→
   263→3. Extract filename
   264→   ↓
   265→   filename := "note" (without .md)
   266→
   267→4. Lookup object ID
   268→   ↓
   269→   objectID := objectMap.Get("note")
   270→
   271→5. Create delete request
   272→   ↓
   273→   ObjectListDelete(objectID)
   274→
   275→6. Add authentication
   276→   ↓
   277→   ctx = withAuth(ctx, sessionToken)
   278→
   279→7. Send to AnyType
   280→   ↓
   281→   resp := client.ObjectListDelete(ctx, req)
   282→
   283→8. Remove from map
   284→   ↓
   285→   objectMap.Delete("note")
   286→
   287→9. Log success
   288→   ↓
   289→   ✓ note deleted from AnyType
   290→```

   292→## Security Model
   293→
   294→### Authentication Chain
   295→
   296→```
   297→1. Account Creation
   298→   anytype auth create bot-name --network-config ...
   299→   ↓
   300→   Generates: Account Key (private key)
   301→
   302→2. Login
   303→   anytype auth login --account-key KEY
   304→   ↓
   305→   Stores: Account Key in ~/.anytype/config.json
   306→
   307→3. Server Start
   308→   anytype serve -q
   309→   ↓
   310→   Auto-login: Reads account key
   311→   Generates: Session Token (JWT)
   312→   Stores: Session Token in config.json
   313→
   314→4. Workspace Sync
   315→   Reads: Session Token from config.json
   316→   Sends: Token with every gRPC request
   317→   ↓
   318→   Server validates: Token signature and expiry
   319→```
   320→
   321→### Security Boundaries
   322→
   323→1. **Local Only**: gRPC server binds to `127.0.0.1` (not accessible remotely)
   324→2. **Session Tokens**: Short-lived, rotated on server restart
   325→3. **Account Keys**: Long-lived, stored encrypted on disk
   326→4. **File Permissions**: Config files readable only by root
   327→
   328→### Threat Model
   329→
   330→**Protected Against**:
   331→- ✅ Remote access (localhost binding)
   332→- ✅ Unauthorized local processes (session token required)
   333→- ✅ Token theft (short-lived)
   334→
   335→**Not Protected Against**:
   336→- ❌ Root-level compromise
   337→- ❌ Session token expiry (requires restart)
   338→- ❌ Account key theft

   340→## Performance Characteristics
   341→
   342→### Latency
   343→
   344→| Operation | Typical Time | Notes |
   345→|-----------|-------------|-------|
   346→| File detection | <1s | fsnotify is immediate |
   347→| Debounce delay | 2s | Prevents duplicate events |
   348→| gRPC object create | 100-300ms | Network + processing |
   349→| gRPC object delete | 50-150ms | Faster than create |
   350→| Total create sync | ~2.5s | Detection + debounce + RPC |
   351→| Total delete sync | ~2.5s | Detection + debounce + RPC |

   357→| CPU | <1% | 2-5% |
   358→| Memory | 20-30 MB | 40-50 MB |
   359→| Disk I/O | Minimal | < 1 KB/s |
   360→| Network | 0 | < 10 KB/s |

   362→### Scalability

   364→| Metric | Limit | Notes |

   371→## Error Handling
   372→
   373→### Retry Strategy
   374→
   375→**No Retries**: Currently, failed operations are logged but not retried.
   376→
   377→**Rationale**:
   378→- File changes can be re-triggered by modifying the file again
   379→- Automatic retry could mask authentication issues
   380→- Systemd handles service-level restarts
   381→
   382→### Error Categories
   383→
   384→1. **Authentication Errors** (`Unauthenticated`)
   385→   - Action: Log error
   386→   - Recovery: Restart services
   387→   - Prevention: Implement token refresh
   388→
   389→2. **Network Errors** (`Unavailable`)
   390→   - Action: Log error
   391→   - Recovery: Service auto-restart
   392→   - Prevention: Health checks
   393→
   394→3. **Application Errors** (`InvalidArgument`, `Internal`)
   395→   - Action: Log error with details
   396→   - Recovery: Manual investigation
   397→   - Prevention: Input validation
   398→
   399→### Logging
   400→
   401→**Format**: RFC3339 timestamp + message
   402→```
   403→[2026-03-01T12:00:00Z] ✓ file synced to AnyType
   404→```
   405→
   406→**Levels**:
   407→- `✓` Success
   408→- `⚠` Warning (non-fatal)
   409→- `✗` Error (operation failed)
   410→- `→` Debug/Info
   411→
   412→**Destinations**:
   413→- Stdout → systemd journal
   414→- Journal → `journalctl -u anytype-workspace-sync`

   416→## Design Decisions
   417→
   418→### Why Filesystem-Based?
   419→
   420→**Pros**:
   421→- ✅ Simple interface (any tool can write files)
   422→- ✅ Version control friendly (git works)
   423→- ✅ No API learning curve
   424→- ✅ Observable (can see files)
   425→
   426→**Cons**:
   427→- ❌ Not real-time (2s debounce)
   428→- ❌ No conflict resolution
   429→- ❌ Filesystem limits apply
   430→
   431→**Alternative Considered**: Direct gRPC API
   432→- Rejected: Requires every client to understand AnyType protocol
   433→
   434→### Why Session Tokens?
   435→
   436→**Pros**:
   437→- ✅ No password in memory
   438→- ✅ Can be revoked
   439→- ✅ Time-limited
   440→
   441→**Cons**:
   442→- ❌ Expire quickly
   443→- ❌ Require server restart to refresh
   444→
   445→**Alternative Considered**: Account Key directly
   446→- Rejected: Security risk (long-lived credential)
   447→
   448→### Why Object Map?
   449→
   450→**Pros**:
   451→- ✅ Enables delete operations
   452→- ✅ Survives restarts
   453→- ✅ Simple JSON format
   454→
   455→**Cons**:
   456→- ❌ Can get out of sync
   457→- ❌ No garbage collection
   458→
   459→**Alternative Considered**: Query AnyType for object by name
   460→- Rejected: API doesn't support efficient name-based lookup
   461→
   462→### Why Go?
   463→
   464→**Pros**:
   465→- ✅ Static binary (easy deployment)
   466→- ✅ Good gRPC support
   467→- ✅ Cross-compilation
   468→- ✅ AnyType SDK in Go
   469→
   470→**Cons**:
   471→- ❌ Larger binary size (~10 MB)
   472→- ❌ GC overhead (minimal)
   473→
   474→**Alternative Considered**: Python
   475→- Rejected: Requires runtime, slower gRPC

   477→## Future Enhancements
   478→
   479→### 1. Token Refresh
   480→**Problem**: Session tokens expire
   481→**Solution**: Implement automatic refresh
   482→```go
   483→if resp.Error == "Unauthenticated" {
   484→    token := refreshToken(accountKey)
   485→    retry(request, token)
   486→}
   487→```
   488→
   489→### 2. Bidirectional Sync
   490→**Problem**: Changes in AnyType don't reflect in files
   491→**Solution**: Subscribe to space changes
   492→```go
   493→stream := client.ObjectSubscribe(spaceID)
   494→for change := range stream {
   495→    writeFile(change.ObjectId, change.Content)
   496→}
   497→```
   498→
   499→### 3. Conflict Resolution
   500→**Problem**: Simultaneous changes cause data loss
   501→**Solution**: Implement last-write-wins or merge
   502→```go
   503→if localModTime > remoteModTime {
   504→    pushToRemote()
   505→} else {
   506→    pullFromRemote()
   507→}
   508→```
   509→
   510→### 4. Health Endpoint
   511→**Problem**: Hard to monitor service health
   512→**Solution**: HTTP health check
   513→```go
   514→http.HandleFunc("/health", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
   515→    if isHealthy() {
   516→        w.WriteHeader(200)
   517→    } else {
   518→        w.WriteHeader(500)
   519→    }
   520→})
   521→```

   631→# Backup script

   633→tar -czf anytype-backup-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz \
   634→    /root/anytype-workspace \
   635→    /root/.anytype/config.json \
   636→    /root/.anytype-workspace-objectmap.json
   637→```
   638→
   639→### Upgrade Procedure
   640→
   641→1. Stop service: `systemctl stop anytype-workspace-sync`
   642→2. Backup: Run backup script
   643→3. Build new binary: `go build -o anytype-workspace-sync-bin`
   644→4. Deploy: `scp anytype-workspace-sync-bin root@VPS:/root/`
   645→5. Start service: `systemctl start anytype-workspace-sync`
   646→6. Verify: `journalctl -u anytype-workspace-sync -n 50`

   224→## Part 4: Install Workspace Sync

   439→## Troubleshooting
   440→
   441→### Problem: "not authenticated - check network membership"
   442→
   443→**Solution**:
   444→```bash
   445→# Restart both services
   446→pkill -f 'anytype serve'
   447→sleep 2
   448→nohup /root/.local/bin/anytype serve -q > /tmp/anytype-serve.log 2>&1 &
   449→sleep 5
   450→systemctl restart anytype-workspace-sync
   451→```
   452→
   453→### Problem: Files not syncing
   454→
   455→**Check**:
   456→1. Service running: `systemctl status anytype-workspace-sync`
   457→2. AnyType running: `ps aux | grep 'anytype serve'`
   458→3. Logs: `journalctl -u anytype-workspace-sync -n 50`
   459→
   460→### Problem: Space not found
   461→
   462→**Check**:
   463→1. Space is joined: `/root/.local/bin/anytype space list`
   464→2. Correct space ID in `main.go`
   465→3. Service restarted after changing `main.go`
   466→
   467→### Problem: Can't join space
   468→
   469→**Check**:
   470→1. Account created with correct network: `/root/.local/bin/anytype auth status`
   471→2. AnyType server running: `ss -tlnp | grep 31010`
   472→3. Valid invite link (not expired)
   473→4. Network configuration correct: `cat /var/lib/anytype/data/client-config.yml`

1→# OpenClaw + MongoDB + AnyType System Flow
     2→
     3→This document illustrates the complete data flow between OpenClaw, MongoDB, and AnyType workspace sync.
     4→
     5→## System Architecture Diagram
     6→
     7→```mermaid
     8→graph TB
     9→    subgraph "OpenClaw Bot"
    10→        OC[OpenClaw Process]
    11→        OCLogic[Bot Logic]
    12→    end
    13→
    14→    subgraph "MongoDB Database"
    15→        DB[(MongoDB)]
    16→        Notes[notes collection]
    17→        Tasks[tasks collection]
    18→        Events[events collection]
    19→    end
    20→
    21→    subgraph "VPS File System"
    22→        WS[/root/anytype-workspace/]
    23→        MD1[note1.md]
    24→        MD2[note2.md]
    25→        MD3[task.md]
    26→        ObjMap[.anytype-workspace-objectmap.json]
    27→    end
    28→
    29→    subgraph "Workspace Sync Service"
    30→        WSSync[anytype-workspace-sync-bin]
    31→        FSNotify[fsnotify Watcher]
    32→        ObjTracker[Object Map Manager]
    33→        GRPCClient[gRPC Client]
    34→    end
    35→
    36→    subgraph "AnyType Local Server"
    37→        ATServe[anytype serve -q]
    38→        GRPCServer[gRPC Server :31010]
    39→        AuthMgr[Session Token Auth]
    40→        ConfigFile[~/.anytype/config.json]
    41→    end
    42→
    43→    subgraph "AnyType Self-Hosted Network"
    44→        Space[AnyType Space]
    45→        Coordinator[Coordinator Node]
    46→        Consensus[Consensus Node]
    47→        FileNode[File Storage Node]
    48→    end
    49→
    50→    %% OpenClaw to MongoDB
    51→    OC -->|1. Store bot data| DB
    52→    OCLogic -->|2. Query/Update| Notes
    53→    OCLogic -->|3. Query/Update| Tasks
    54→    OCLogic -->|4. Log events| Events
    55→
    56→    %% MongoDB to OpenClaw
    57→    DB -->|5. Change streams| OC
    58→    Notes -->|6. Read data| OCLogic
    59→
    60→    %% OpenClaw to Workspace
    61→    OC -->|7. Write .md files| WS
    62→    OCLogic -->|8. Create note1.md| MD1
    63→    OCLogic -->|9. Create note2.md| MD2
    64→    OCLogic -->|10. Create task.md| MD3
    65→
    66→    %% Workspace to Sync Service
    67→    WS -->|11. Watch directory| FSNotify
    68→    MD1 -->|12. CREATE event| FSNotify
    69→    MD2 -->|13. WRITE event| FSNotify
    70→    MD3 -->|14. REMOVE event| FSNotify
    71→
    72→    %% Sync Service Processing
    73→    FSNotify -->|15. Notify change| WSSync
    74→    WSSync -->|16. Parse markdown| WSSync
    75→    WSSync -->|17. Track object IDs| ObjTracker
    76→    ObjTracker -->|18. Store mapping| ObjMap
    77→    ObjMap -->|19. Retrieve object ID| ObjTracker
    78→
    79→    %% Sync Service to gRPC
    80→    WSSync -->|20. Send RPC request| GRPCClient
    81→    GRPCClient -->|21. ObjectCreate/Delete| GRPCServer
    82→
    83→    %% Authentication Flow
    84→    GRPCClient -->|22. Read session token| ConfigFile
    85→    ConfigFile -->|23. Return token| GRPCClient
    86→    GRPCClient -->|24. Add auth metadata| GRPCClient
    87→    GRPCServer -->|25. Validate token| AuthMgr
    88→    AuthMgr -->|26. Check session| ATServe
    89→
    90→    %% AnyType Server to Space
    91→    ATServe -->|27. Sync objects| Space
    92→    Space -->|28. Replicate| Coordinator
    93→    Coordinator -->|29. Consensus| Consensus
    94→    Space -->|30. Store files| FileNode
    95→
    96→    %% Reverse flow (from Space to OpenClaw)
    97→    Space -.->|31. Future: bidirectional sync| ATServe
    98→    ATServe -.->|32. Future: notify changes| WSSync
    99→    WSSync -.->|33. Future: write files| WS
   100→    WS -.->|34. Future: trigger update| OC
   101→
   102→    style OC fill:#e1f5ff
   103→    style DB fill:#ffe1e1
   104→    style WSSync fill:#e1ffe1
   105→    style ATServe fill:#fff4e1
   106→    style Space fill:#f0e1ff
   107→    style ObjMap fill:#ffe1f0
   108→```
   109→
   110→## Sequence Diagram: Create Flow
   111→
   112→```mermaid
   113→sequenceDiagram
   114→    participant OC as OpenClaw Bot
   115→    participant DB as MongoDB
   116→    participant FS as File System
   117→    participant WS as Workspace Sync
   118→    participant AT as AnyType Server
   119→    participant SP as AnyType Space
   120→
   121→    Note over OC,SP: File Creation Flow
   122→
   123→    OC->>DB: 1. Store note data
   124→    DB-->>OC: Confirm stored
   125→
   126→    OC->>FS: 2. Write /root/anytype-workspace/my-note.md
   127→
   128→    FS->>WS: 3. fsnotify: CREATE event
   129→
   130→    WS->>WS: 4. Parse markdown (extract title)
   131→    WS->>WS: 5. Debounce (wait 2s)
   132→
   133→    WS->>AT: 6. Read ~/.anytype/config.json
   134→    AT-->>WS: 7. Return session token
   135→
   136→    WS->>AT: 8. gRPC: ObjectCreate(title, content)
   137→    Note over WS,AT: Auth: metadata["token"] = sessionToken
   138→
   139→    AT->>AT: 9. Validate session token

   239→## Authentication Flow
   240→
   241→```mermaid
   242→sequenceDiagram
   243→    participant CLI as anytype CLI
   244→    participant CFG as ~/.anytype/config.json
   245→    participant SRV as anytype serve
   246→    participant WS as Workspace Sync
   247→    participant GRPC as gRPC Server
   248→
   249→    Note over CLI,GRPC: Initial Setup (one-time)
   250→
   251→    CLI->>CLI: 1. anytype auth login --account-key
   252→    CLI->>CFG: 2. Store account credentials
   253→    CLI->>SRV: 3. anytype serve -q (background)
   254→    SRV->>CFG: 4. Create session token (JWT)
   255→
   256→    Note over CLI,GRPC: Runtime Authentication (every request)
   257→
   258→    WS->>WS: 5. Start workspace-sync-bin
   259→    WS->>CFG: 6. Read session token
   260→    CFG-->>WS: 7. Return JWT token
   261→
   262→    WS->>GRPC: 8. gRPC call + metadata["token"]
   263→    GRPC->>GRPC: 9. Validate JWT signature
   264→    GRPC->>GRPC: 10. Check token expiry
   265→
   266→    alt Token Valid
   267→        GRPC-->>WS: 11. Success + response
   268→    else Token Expired
   269→        GRPC-->>WS: 12. Error: not authenticated
   270→        WS->>SRV: 13. Detect auth error
   271→        WS->>SRV: 14. Trigger token refresh
   272→        Note over WS,SRV: Future: automatic renewal
   273→    end
   274→```

   276→## Data Flow Summary
   277→
   278→### 1. OpenClaw → MongoDB (Primary Data Store)
   279→- OpenClaw stores all bot state, notes, tasks in MongoDB
   280→- Uses MongoDB change streams for real-time updates
   281→- MongoDB is source of truth for bot logic
   282→
   283→### 2. OpenClaw → File System (Export)
   284→- OpenClaw writes markdown files to `/root/anytype-workspace/`
   285→- Each note in MongoDB can generate a corresponding .md file
   286→- File names are slug-ified note titles
   287→
   288→### 3. File System → Workspace Sync (Watch)
   289→- `fsnotify` watches directory for changes (CREATE, WRITE, REMOVE)
   290→- 2-second debounce prevents duplicate syncs
   291→- Tracks file modification timestamps
   292→
   293→### 4. Workspace Sync → Object Map (Tracking)
   294→- Maps filenames to AnyType object IDs
   295→- Stored in `/root/.anytype-workspace-objectmap.json`
   296→- Required for delete operations
   297→- Thread-safe with mutex locks
   298→
   299→### 5. Workspace Sync → AnyType Server (gRPC)
   300→- Connects to `127.0.0.1:31010`
   301→- Uses session token from `~/.anytype/config.json`
   302→- RPC methods: `ObjectCreate`, `ObjectListDelete`, `WorkspaceOpen`
   303→
   304→### 6. AnyType Server → Space (Sync)
   305→- `anytype serve` maintains connection to self-hosted network
   306→- Syncs objects to coordinator, consensus, and file nodes
   307→- Handles network-level replication
   308→
   309→## File Locations
   310→
   311→| Component | Location | Purpose |
   312→|-----------|----------|---------|
   313→| OpenClaw Bot | `/path/to/openclaw/` | Bot application |
   314→| MongoDB | `mongodb://localhost:27017` | Primary database |
   315→| Workspace Dir | `/root/anytype-workspace/` | Markdown files |
   316→| Sync Service | `/root/anytype-workspace-sync-bin` | File watcher |
   317→| Object Map | `/root/.anytype-workspace-objectmap.json` | ID mappings |
   318→| AnyType Config | `/root/.anytype/config.json` | Session token |
   319→| AnyType Server | `/root/.local/bin/anytype` | CLI + server |
   320→| Network Config | `/var/lib/anytype/data/client-config.yml` | Network nodes |

   358→## Performance Characteristics
   359→
   360→- **File Change Detection**: < 1 second (fsnotify)
   361→- **Debounce Time**: 2 seconds (prevents duplicate syncs)
   362→- **gRPC Object Creation**: 100-300ms
   363→- **Total Sync Latency**: ~2-5 seconds (file write → AnyType object)
   364→- **MongoDB Query**: 10-50ms (local network)
   365→- **Network Sync**: Varies (depends on network topology)
   366→

   370→   - AnyType changes → File System

   375→   - Detect auth failures

   384→   - OpenClaw receives sync completion events

    29→### 1. "not authenticated - check network membership"

    44→sleep 5
    45→systemctl restart anytype-workspace-sync
    46→
    47→# Verify

   106→```bash

   115→

   132→### 4. Delete Not Working

   134→**Symptoms**:
   135→- Delete file locally

   166→
   167→# All files will resync and rebuild map

   255→### 7. Object Map Out of Sync
   256→
   257→**Symptoms**:
   258→- Files exist but not in map
   259→- Map has entries for deleted files
   260→- Delete fails with "No object ID found"
   261→
   262→**Diagnosis**:
   263→```bash
   264→# List files
   265→ls /root/anytype-workspace/*.md | sed 's/.*\///' | sed 's/\.md$//' | sort > /tmp/files.txt
   266→
   267→# List map entries
   268→jq -r 'keys[]' /root/.anytype-workspace-objectmap.json | sort > /tmp/map.txt
   269→
   270→# Compare
   271→diff /tmp/files.txt /tmp/map.txt
   272→```
   273→
   274→**Fix**:
   275→
   276→**Reset and resync**:
   277→```bash
   278→# Backup
   279→cp /root/.anytype-workspace-objectmap.json /root/map-backup.json
   280→
   281→# Reset
   282→rm /root/.anytype-workspace-objectmap.json
   283→
   284→# Restart (will resync all files)
   285→systemctl restart anytype-workspace-sync
   286→
   287→# This creates duplicate objects in AnyType!
   288→# Clean up duplicates manually in AnyType UI
   289→```
   290→
   291→**Selective fix**:
   292→```bash
   293→# Remove orphaned map entries manually
   294→jq 'del(.["deleted-file"])' /root/.anytype-workspace-objectmap.json > /tmp/map-new.json
   295→mv /tmp/map-new.json /root/.anytype-workspace-objectmap.json
   296→
   297→# Restart
   298→systemctl restart anytype-workspace-sync
   299→```

1→# Automatic Token Renewal - Technical Documentation
     2→
     3→## Overview
     4→
     5→The AnyType Workspace Sync service now includes intelligent automatic token renewal to handle session token expiry without manual intervention. This feature provides self-healing capabilities that keep the service running reliably even when AnyType session tokens expire.
     6→
     7→## Problem Statement
     8→
     9→AnyType uses JWT session tokens for authentication. These tokens:
    10→- Are generated when `anytype serve` starts
    11→- Are stored in `~/.anytype/config.json`
    12→- Expire after a certain period
    13→- Require the AnyType server to be restarted to refresh
    14→
    15→**Before v1.1.0**, when a token expired:
    16→1. All sync operations would fail with "not authenticated" errors
    17→2. Manual intervention required:
    18→   - Kill `anytype serve` process
    19→   - Restart `anytype serve`
    20→   - Restart `anytype-workspace-sync` service
    21→3. Downtime during the manual recovery process
    22→
    23→## Solution: Automatic Token Renewal
    24→
    25→The service now automatically detects authentication failures and performs a self-healing recovery:
    26→
    27→```mermaid
    28→sequenceDiagram
    29→    participant WS as Workspace Sync
    30→    participant API as API Operation
    31→    participant AT as AnyType Server
    32→    participant CFG as Config File
    33→
    34→    WS->>API: Perform sync operation
    35→    API->>AT: gRPC call with token
    36→    AT-->>API: Error: not authenticated
    37→
    38→    Note over WS,AT: Automatic Recovery Triggered
    39→
    40→    API->>API: Detect auth error
    41→    API->>API: Check rate limit (30s)
    42→
    43→    API->>AT: pkill -f 'anytype serve'
    44→    Note over AT: Server stopped
    45→
    46→    API->>API: Wait 3 seconds
    47→
    48→    API->>AT: Start: nohup anytype serve -q
    49→    Note over AT: Server starting...
    50→
    51→    API->>API: Wait 8 seconds for initialization
    52→
    53→    API->>CFG: Read new session token
    54→    CFG-->>API: Return fresh JWT token
    55→
    56→    API->>API: Update sessionToken field
    57→
    58→    API->>AT: Retry gRPC call with new token
    59→    AT-->>API: Success!
    60→
    61→    API-->>WS: Operation completed successfully
    62→```
    63→
    64→## Implementation Details
    65→
    66→### 1. Authentication Error Detection
    67→
    68→```go
    69→func isAuthError(err error) bool {
    70→    if err == nil {
    71→        return false
    72→    }
    73→    errMsg := strings.ToLower(err.Error())
    74→    return strings.Contains(errMsg, "not authenticated") ||
    75→        strings.Contains(errMsg, "authentication failed") ||
    76→        strings.Contains(errMsg, "invalid token") ||
    77→        strings.Contains(errMsg, "session") ||
    78→        strings.Contains(errMsg, "signature is invalid")
    79→}
    80→```
    81→
    82→The system checks error messages for authentication-related keywords:
    83→- `"not authenticated"`
    84→- `"authentication failed"`
    85→- `"invalid token"`
    86→- `"session"`
    87→- `"signature is invalid"`
    88→
    89→### 2. Token Refresh Process
    90→
    91→```go
    92→func (c *AnyTypeClient) refreshToken(ctx context.Context) error {
    93→    // 1. Rate limiting check
    94→    if time.Since(c.lastRefresh) < 30*time.Second {
    95→        return fmt.Errorf("token refresh rate limit")
    96→    }
    97→
    98→    // 2. Kill existing anytype server
    99→    exec.Command("pkill", "-f", "anytype serve").Run()
   100→
   101→    // 3. Wait for clean shutdown
   102→    time.Sleep(3 * time.Second)
   103→
   104→    // 4. Start new anytype server
   105→    startCmd := exec.Command("nohup", c.anytypeBinary, "serve", "-q")
   106→    startCmd.Stdout = logFile
   107→    startCmd.Stderr = logFile
   108→    startCmd.Start()
   109→
   110→    // 5. Wait for server initialization
   111→    time.Sleep(8 * time.Second)
   112→
   113→    // 6. Reload token from config
   114→    newToken, err := readSessionToken()
   115→
   116→    // 7. Update client's token
   117→    c.sessionToken = newToken
   118→    c.lastRefresh = time.Now()
   119→
   120→    return nil
   121→}
   122→```
   123→
   124→**Key Steps**:
   125→1. **Rate Limiting**: Prevents refresh loops (max 1 refresh per 30 seconds)
   126→2. **Clean Shutdown**: Kills existing `anytype serve` process
   127→3. **Wait Period**: 3-second delay ensures process fully stops
   128→4. **Restart Server**: Starts new `anytype serve` in background
   129→5. **Initialization Wait**: 8-second delay for server to start and generate new token
   130→6. **Token Reload**: Reads fresh token from `~/.anytype/config.json`
   131→7. **Update State**: Stores new token and timestamp
   132→
   133→### 3. Retry Logic
   134→
   135→```go
   136→func (c *AnyTypeClient) withRetry(ctx context.Context, operation func() error) error {
   137→    // Try operation first
   138→    err := operation()
   139→
   140→    // If success or non-auth error, return immediately
   141→    if err == nil || !isAuthError(err) {
   142→        return err
   143→    }
   144→
   145→    // Auth error detected - refresh token
   146→    fmt.Printf("⚠ Authentication error detected: %v\n", err)
   147→
   148→    if refreshErr := c.refreshToken(ctx); refreshErr != nil {
   149→        return fmt.Errorf("auth error (token refresh failed): %w", err)
   150→    }
   151→
   152→    // Retry operation with new token
   153→    fmt.Printf("🔁 Retrying operation with refreshed token...\n")
   154→    return operation()
   155→}
   156→```
   157→
   158→All authenticated operations are wrapped with `withRetry()`:
   159→- `SyncMarkdownWithID()` - Create/update objects
   160→- `DeleteMarkdown()` - Delete objects
   161→- `OpenSpace()` - Open workspace
   162→
   163→### 4. Thread Safety
   164→
   165→```go
   166→type AnyTypeClient struct {
   167→    conn          *grpc.ClientConn
   168→    addr          string
   169→    sessionToken  string
   170→    refreshMutex  sync.Mutex  // Prevents concurrent refreshes
   171→    lastRefresh   time.Time   // Tracks last refresh time
   172→    anytypeBinary string
   173→}
   174→```
   175→
   176→**Concurrency Control**:
   177→- `refreshMutex` ensures only one token refresh happens at a time
   178→- Multiple goroutines can trigger refresh, but only one proceeds
   179→- Others wait and reuse the refreshed token
   180→

   190→| **Rate Limit** | 30 seconds | Minimum time between refresh attempts |

   253→## Performance Impact
   254→
   255→### Overhead
   256→
   257→| Aspect | Impact |
   258→|--------|--------|
   259→| **Normal Operation** | Zero overhead (only triggered on auth errors) |
   260→| **During Refresh** | ~11 seconds total (3s shutdown + 8s startup) |
   261→| **Failed Operations** | 1 retry attempt per operation |
   262→| **Memory** | +~10 KB (mutex + timestamps) |
   263→
   264→### Recovery Time
   265→
   266→```
   267→Token Expires → Error Detected → Refresh Triggered → Server Restart → Token Reload → Retry → Success
   268→     0s              +0.1s              +0.2s              +11s             +11.5s      +12s      ✓
   269→```
   270→
   271→**Total Recovery Time**: ~12 seconds from first auth error to successful retry
   272→
   273→### Efficiency
   274→
   275→- **No Downtime**: Service continues running during refresh
   276→- **No Manual Intervention**: Fully automatic
   277→- **Rate Limited**: Prevents refresh storms
   278→- **Thread Safe**: Multiple operations can proceed safely

   319→## Troubleshooting
   320→
   321→### Token Refresh Not Working
   322→
   323→**Check**:
   324→1. AnyType binary path is correct:
   325→   ```bash
   326→   ls -l /root/.local/bin/anytype
   327→   ```
   328→
   329→2. Service has permission to kill/start processes:
   330→   ```bash
   331→   systemctl show anytype-workspace-sync | grep User
   332→   # Should show: User=root
   333→   ```
   334→
   335→3. Config file is readable:
   336→   ```bash
   337→   cat ~/.anytype/config.json | jq .sessionToken
   338→   ```
   339→
   340→### Refresh Happening Too Often
   341→
   342→If you see frequent refreshes, check:
   343→
   344→```bash
   345→# Count refreshes in last hour
   346→journalctl -u anytype-workspace-sync --since "1 hour ago" | grep -c "Session token refreshed"
   347→
   348→# If > 2, investigate root cause
   349→journalctl -u anytype-workspace-sync -p err --since "1 hour ago"
   350→```
   351→
   352→**Possible causes**:
   353→- Network issues causing intermittent failures
   354→- AnyType server crashing frequently
   355→- Corrupted config file
   356→
   357→### Manual Override
   358→
   359→If automatic refresh fails, manual recovery:
   360→
   361→```bash
   362→# Stop everything
   363→systemctl stop anytype-workspace-sync
   364→pkill -f 'anytype serve'
   365→
   366→# Wait
   367→sleep 5
   368→
   369→# Start anytype server
   370→nohup /root/.local/bin/anytype serve -q > /tmp/anytype-serve.log 2>&1 &
   371→
   372→# Wait for startup
   373→sleep 10
   374→
   375→# Restart sync service
   376→systemctl start anytype-workspace-sync
   377→
   378→# Verify
   379→journalctl -u anytype-workspace-sync -n 20
   380→```

   382→## Security Considerations
   383→
   384→### Process Control
   385→
   386→The service requires permission to:
   387→- Kill `anytype serve` processes
   388→- Start new `anytype serve` processes
   389→- Read `~/.anytype/config.json`
   390→
   391→**Recommendation**: Run as `root` or dedicated user with appropriate permissions.
   392→
   393→### Token Storage
   394→
   395→Session tokens are:
   396→- Stored in `~/.anytype/config.json`
   397→- Read-only to owner (mode 0600 recommended)
   398→- Refreshed automatically, never logged
   399→
   400→**Security Best Practices**:
   401→```bash
   402→# Secure config file
   403→chmod 600 ~/.anytype/config.json
   404→
   405→# Secure object map
   406→chmod 600 ~/.anytype-workspace-objectmap.json
   407→
   408→# Secure log file (contains no sensitive data)
   409→chmod 644 /tmp/anytype-serve.log
   410→```
   411→
   412→### Rate Limiting Security
   413→
   414→The 30-second rate limit prevents:
   415→- Accidental DoS from refresh loops
   416→- Rapid server restarts causing instability
   417→- Log spam from repeated failures
   418→

    69→// readSessionToken reads the session token from AnyType config

    89→// isAuthError checks if an error is an authentication error
    90→func isAuthError(err error) bool {
    91→	if err == nil {
    92→		return false
    93→	}
    94→	errMsg := strings.ToLower(err.Error())
    95→	return strings.Contains(errMsg, "not authenticated") ||
    96→		strings.Contains(errMsg, "authentication failed") ||
    97→		strings.Contains(errMsg, "invalid token") ||
    98→		strings.Contains(errMsg, "session") ||
    99→		strings.Contains(errMsg, "signature is invalid")
   100→}

   102→// refreshToken attempts to refresh the session token by restarting the anytype server
   103→func (c *AnyTypeClient) refreshToken(ctx context.Context) error {
   104→	c.refreshMutex.Lock()
   105→	defer c.refreshMutex.Unlock()
   106→
   107→	// Check if we recently refreshed (within last 30 seconds)
   108→	// This prevents rapid refresh loops
   109→	if time.Since(c.lastRefresh) < 30*time.Second {
   110→		fmt.Printf("[%s] Token refresh attempted too soon, skipping\n", time.Now().Format(time.RFC3339))
   111→		return fmt.Errorf("token refresh rate limit")
   112→	}
   113→
   114→	fmt.Printf("[%s] 🔄 Attempting to refresh session token...\n", time.Now().Format(time.RFC3339))
   115→
   116→	// Step 1: Kill existing anytype serve process
   117→	fmt.Printf("[%s]   → Stopping anytype server...\n", time.Now().Format(time.RFC3339))
   118→	killCmd := exec.Command("pkill", "-f", "anytype serve")
   119→	if err := killCmd.Run(); err != nil {
   120→		// It's okay if pkill fails (process may not be running)
   121→		fmt.Printf("[%s]   ⚠ pkill returned: %v (may be normal)\n", time.Now().Format(time.RFC3339), err)
   122→	}
   123→
   124→	// Step 2: Wait for process to fully stop
   125→	time.Sleep(3 * time.Second)
   126→
   127→	// Step 3: Start anytype server in background
   128→	fmt.Printf("[%s]   → Starting anytype server...\n", time.Now().Format(time.RFC3339))
   129→	startCmd := exec.Command("nohup", c.anytypeBinary, "serve", "-q")
   130→
   131→	// Redirect output to log file
   132→	logFile, err := os.OpenFile("/tmp/anytype-serve.log", os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY|os.O_APPEND, 0644)
   133→	if err != nil {
   134→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to open log file: %w", err)
   135→	}
   136→	defer logFile.Close()
   137→
   138→	startCmd.Stdout = logFile
   139→	startCmd.Stderr = logFile
   140→
   141→	if err := startCmd.Start(); err != nil {
   142→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to start anytype server: %w", err)
   143→	}
   144→
   145→	// Step 4: Wait for server to initialize and generate new token
   146→	fmt.Printf("[%s]   → Waiting for server to initialize...\n", time.Now().Format(time.RFC3339))
   147→	time.Sleep(8 * time.Second)
   148→
   149→	// Step 5: Reload session token from config
   150→	fmt.Printf("[%s]   → Reading new session token...\n", time.Now().Format(time.RFC3339))
   151→	newToken, err := readSessionToken()
   152→	if err != nil {
   153→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to read new token: %w", err)
   154→	}
   155→
   156→	// Step 6: Update client's session token
   157→	c.sessionToken = newToken
   158→	c.lastRefresh = time.Now()
   159→
   160→	// Step 7: Reconnect gRPC — the old connection died when anytype restarted
   161→	fmt.Printf("[%s]   → Reconnecting gRPC to %s...\n", time.Now().Format(time.RFC3339), c.addr)
   162→	if c.conn != nil {
   163→		c.conn.Close()
   164→	}
   165→	connCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
   166→	defer cancel()
   167→	newConn, err := grpc.DialContext(
   168→		connCtx,
   169→		c.addr,
   170→		grpc.WithTransportCredentials(insecure.NewCredentials()),
   171→		grpc.WithBlock(),
   172→	)
   173→	if err != nil {
   174→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to reconnect gRPC after token refresh: %w", err)
   175→	}
   176→	c.conn = newConn
   177→
   178→	fmt.Printf("[%s] ✓ Session token refreshed and gRPC reconnected\n", time.Now().Format(time.RFC3339))
   179→	return nil
   180→}

   182→// withRetry wraps an operation with automatic token refresh on auth errors
   183→func (c *AnyTypeClient) withRetry(ctx context.Context, operation func() error) error {
   184→	err := operation()
   185→
   186→	// If no error or not an auth error, return immediately
   187→	if err == nil || !isAuthError(err) {
   188→		return err
   189→	}
   190→
   191→	// Auth error detected - try to refresh token
   192→	fmt.Printf("[%s] ⚠ Authentication error detected: %v\n", time.Now().Format(time.RFC3339), err)
   193→
   194→	if refreshErr := c.refreshToken(ctx); refreshErr != nil {
   195→		fmt.Printf("[%s] ✗ Token refresh failed: %v\n", time.Now().Format(time.RFC3339), refreshErr)
   196→		return fmt.Errorf("auth error (token refresh failed): %w", err)
   197→	}
   198→
   199→	// Retry the operation with new token
   200→	fmt.Printf("[%s] 🔁 Retrying operation with refreshed token...\n", time.Now().Format(time.RFC3339))
   201→	err = operation()
   202→
   203→	if err != nil {
   204→		return fmt.Errorf("operation failed after token refresh: %w", err)
   205→	}
   206→
   207→	return nil
   208→}

   117→// addContentBlocks writes markdown text as paragraph blocks into the body of an AnyType object.
   118→// It uses ObjectShow to locate the correct anchor point in the block tree, then chains
   119→// BlockCreate calls so each line lands in the visible document body.
   120→func (c *AnyTypeClient) addContentBlocks(ctx context.Context, objectID string, spaceID string, content string) error {
   121→	fmt.Printf("[%s]   → Adding content blocks (%d bytes)\n", time.Now().Format(time.RFC3339), len(content))
   122→
   123→	// Get the current block tree to find where body content should be inserted
   124→	rootID, blocks, err := c.getObjectBlocks(ctx, objectID, spaceID)
   125→	if err != nil {
   126→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to read block tree: %w", err)
   127→	}
   128→
   129→	// Build id→block map and find the last child of root (the header block) as anchor
   130→	blockMap := make(map[string]*model.Block, len(blocks))
   131→	for _, b := range blocks {
   132→		blockMap[b.Id] = b
   133→	}
   134→	anchorID := ""
   135→	if root := blockMap[rootID]; root != nil && len(root.ChildrenIds) > 0 {
   136→		anchorID = root.ChildrenIds[len(root.ChildrenIds)-1]
   137→	}
   138→
   139→	// Create one block per non-empty line, parsing markdown into native block styles
   140→	created := 0
   141→	for _, line := range strings.Split(content, "\n") {
   142→		if strings.TrimSpace(line) == "" {
   143→			continue
   144→		}
   145→		style, text, marks := parseMarkdownLine(line)
   146→		newID, err := c.createTextBlock(ctx, objectID, anchorID, style, text, marks)
   147→		if err != nil {
   148→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to create block: %w", err)
   149→		}
   150→		anchorID = newID
   151→		created++
   152→	}
   153→
   154→	fmt.Printf("[%s]   → Content blocks added (%d blocks)\n", time.Now().Format(time.RFC3339), created)
   155→	return nil
   156→}

   214→// parseMarkdownLine converts a markdown line into a block style, clean text, and inline marks.
   215→func parseMarkdownLine(line string) (model.BlockContentTextStyle, string, []*model.BlockContentTextMark) {
   216→	style := model.BlockContentText_Paragraph
   217→	text := line
   218→
   219→	switch {
   220→	case strings.HasPrefix(line, "#### "):
   221→		style = model.BlockContentText_Header4
   222→		text = line[5:]
   223→	case strings.HasPrefix(line, "### "):
   224→		style = model.BlockContentText_Header3
   225→		text = line[4:]
   226→	case strings.HasPrefix(line, "## "):
   227→		style = model.BlockContentText_Header2
   228→		text = line[3:]
   229→	case strings.HasPrefix(line, "# "):
   230→		style = model.BlockContentText_Header1
   231→		text = line[2:]
   232→	case strings.HasPrefix(line, "- ") || strings.HasPrefix(line, "* "):
   233→		style = model.BlockContentText_Marked
   234→		text = line[2:]
   235→	case strings.HasPrefix(line, "> "):
   236→		style = model.BlockContentText_Quote
   237→		text = line[2:]
   238→	default:
   239→		// Numbered list: "1. ", "12. ", etc.
   240→		i := 0
   241→		for i < len(line) && line[i] >= '0' && line[i] <= '9' {
   242→			i++
   243→		}
   244→		if i > 0 && i+2 <= len(line) && line[i] == '.' && line[i+1] == ' ' {
   245→			style = model.BlockContentText_Numbered
   246→			text = line[i+2:]
   247→		}
   248→	}
   249→
   250→	cleanText, marks := parseInlineMarks(text)
   251→	return style, cleanText, marks
   252→}
   253→
   254→// parseInlineMarks strips **bold**, *italic*, and `code` markdown syntax from text
   255→// and returns the clean string along with AnyType mark ranges.
   256→func parseInlineMarks(text string) (string, []*model.BlockContentTextMark) {
   257→	var marks []*model.BlockContentTextMark
   258→	var out strings.Builder
   259→	runes := []rune(text)
   260→	n := len(runes)
   261→	i := 0
   262→
   263→	for i < n {
   264→		// Bold: **text** or __text__
   265→		if i+1 < n && ((runes[i] == '*' && runes[i+1] == '*') || (runes[i] == '_' && runes[i+1] == '_')) {
   266→			delim := string(runes[i : i+2])
   267→			rest := string(runes[i+2:])
   268→			end := strings.Index(rest, delim)
   269→			if end >= 0 {
   270→				from := int32(len([]rune(out.String())))
   271→				inner := string(runes[i+2 : i+2+end])
   272→				out.WriteString(inner)
   273→				marks = append(marks, &model.BlockContentTextMark{
   274→					Range: &model.Range{From: from, To: from + int32(len([]rune(inner)))},
   275→					Type:  model.BlockContentTextMark_Bold,
   276→				})
   277→				i = i + 2 + end + 2
   278→				continue
   279→			}
   280→		}
   281→
   282→		// Italic: *text* or _text_ (single, not preceded by same char)
   283→		if (runes[i] == '*' || runes[i] == '_') && (i+1 < n && runes[i+1] != runes[i]) {
   284→			delim := string(runes[i])
   285→			rest := string(runes[i+1:])
   286→			end := strings.Index(rest, delim)
   287→			if end >= 0 {
   288→				from := int32(len([]rune(out.String())))
   289→				inner := string(runes[i+1 : i+1+end])
   290→				out.WriteString(inner)
   291→				marks = append(marks, &model.BlockContentTextMark{
   292→					Range: &model.Range{From: from, To: from + int32(len([]rune(inner)))},
   293→					Type:  model.BlockContentTextMark_Italic,
   294→				})
   295→				i = i + 1 + end + 1
   296→				continue
   297→			}
   298→		}
   299→
   300→		// Inline code: `text`
   301→		if runes[i] == '`' {
   302→			rest := string(runes[i+1:])
   303→			end := strings.Index(rest, "`")
   304→			if end >= 0 {
   305→				from := int32(len([]rune(out.String())))
   306→				inner := string(runes[i+1 : i+1+end])
   307→				out.WriteString(inner)
   308→				marks = append(marks, &model.BlockContentTextMark{
   309→					Range: &model.Range{From: from, To: from + int32(len([]rune(inner)))},
   310→					Type:  model.BlockContentTextMark_Keyboard,
   311→				})
   312→				i = i + 1 + end + 1
   313→				continue
   314→			}
   315→		}
   316→
   317→		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
   318→		i++
   319→	}
   320→
   321→	return out.String(), marks
   322→}

   354→// detectFileType determines the file type based on file extension
   355→func detectFileType(filePath string) model.BlockContentFileType {
   356→	ext := strings.ToLower(filepath.Ext(filePath))
   357→
   358→	switch ext {
   359→	case ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".gif", ".webp", ".bmp", ".svg":
   360→		return model.BlockContentFile_Image
   361→	case ".pdf":
   362→		return model.BlockContentFile_PDF
   363→	case ".mp4", ".mov", ".avi", ".mkv", ".webm":
   364→		return model.BlockContentFile_Video
   365→	case ".mp3", ".wav", ".ogg", ".m4a", ".flac":
   366→		return model.BlockContentFile_Audio
   367→	default:
   368→		return model.BlockContentFile_File
   369→	}
   370→}

   408→// handleGRPCError provides detailed error messages for gRPC failures
   409→func (c *AnyTypeClient) handleGRPCError(err error) error {
   410→	if err == nil {
   411→		return nil
   412→	}
   413→
   414→	st, ok := status.FromError(err)
   415→	if !ok {
   416→		return fmt.Errorf("unknown gRPC error: %w", err)
   417→	}
   418→
   419→	switch st.Code() {
   420→	case codes.OK:
   421→		return nil
   422→	case codes.Unavailable:
   423→		return fmt.Errorf("AnyType service unavailable - check if AnyType is running")
   424→	case codes.DeadlineExceeded:
   425→		return fmt.Errorf("gRPC call timeout")
   426→	case codes.PermissionDenied:
   427→		return fmt.Errorf("permission denied - check credentials or space access")
   428→	case codes.NotFound:
   429→		return fmt.Errorf("space or object not found")
   430→	case codes.InvalidArgument:
   431→		return fmt.Errorf("invalid request: %s", st.Message())
   432→	case codes.Internal:
   433→		return fmt.Errorf("AnyType internal error: %s", st.Message())
   434→	case codes.Unauthenticated:
   435→		return fmt.Errorf("not authenticated - check network membership")
   436→	default:
   437→		return fmt.Errorf("gRPC error %s: %s", st.Code(), st.Message())
   438→	}
   439→}

    13→// ObjectMap tracks the mapping between filenames and AnyType object IDs
    14→type ObjectMap struct {
    15→	mu      sync.RWMutex
    16→	mapping map[string]string // filename -> objectID
    17→}
    18→
    19→// NewObjectMap creates a new object map and loads existing mappings
    20→func NewObjectMap() (*ObjectMap, error) {
    21→	om := &ObjectMap{
    22→		mapping: make(map[string]string),
    23→	}
    24→
    25→	// Try to load existing mappings
    26→	if err := om.load(); err != nil {
    27→		// If file doesn't exist, that's ok
    28→		if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
    29→			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to load object map: %w", err)
    30→		}
    31→	}
    32→
    33→	return om, nil
    34→}
    35→
    36→// Set stores a filename -> objectID mapping
    37→func (om *ObjectMap) Set(filename, objectID string) error {
    38→	om.mu.Lock()
    39→	defer om.mu.Unlock()
    40→
    41→	om.mapping[filename] = objectID
    42→	return om.save()
    43→}
    44→
    45→// Get retrieves the objectID for a filename
    46→func (om *ObjectMap) Get(filename string) (string, bool) {
    47→	om.mu.RLock()
    48→	defer om.mu.RUnlock()
    49→
    50→	objectID, exists := om.mapping[filename]
    51→	return objectID, exists
    52→}
    53→
    54→// Delete removes a filename mapping
    55→func (om *ObjectMap) Delete(filename string) error {
    56→	om.mu.Lock()
    57→	defer om.mu.Unlock()
    58→
    59→	delete(om.mapping, filename)
    60→	return om.save()
    61→}
    62→
    63→// load reads the object map from disk
    64→func (om *ObjectMap) load() error {
    65→	data, err := os.ReadFile(objectMapFile)
    66→	if err != nil {
    67→		return err
    68→	}
    69→
    70→	return json.Unmarshal(data, &om.mapping)
    71→}
    72→
    73→// save writes the object map to disk
    74→func (om *ObjectMap) save() error {
    75→	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(om.mapping, "", "  ")
    76→	if err != nil {
    77→		return err
    78→	}
    79→
    80→	// Ensure directory exists
    81→	dir := filepath.Dir(objectMapFile)
    82→	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0755); err != nil {
    83→		return err
    84→	}
    85→
    86→	return os.WriteFile(objectMapFile, data, 0644)
    87→}
